answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonding each identity in a slashable escrow and correlating equivocation across the same consensus thread: when k coordinated identities sign incompatible histories, the base penalty grows as O(k^2), not linearly. Detection applies an exponential multiplier to the swarm’s capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation prevents recovery of slashed value; splitting stake among identities therefore offers no safe ledge, even in a broad lagoon of pseudonyms.
